parameters.query: SELECT s.id, s.signal_type, s.signal_category, s.title, s.summary, s.severity, s.confidence_score, s.keywords, s.detected_at FROM signals s WHERE s.detected_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' AND s.confidence_score >= 0.6 ORDER BY s.confidence_score DESC, s.detected_at DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT t.trend_name, t.trend_category, t.summary, t.momentum_score, t.direction, t.signal_count FROM trends t WHERE t.is_active = true AND t.momentum_score >= 0.5 ORDER BY t.momentum_score DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT ci.id, ci.title, ci.content_type, ci.target_persona, ci.key_angle, ci.signal_ids, ci.priority_score, ci.created_at FROM content_ideas ci WHERE ci.status = 'approved' AND ci.scheduled_date IS NULL ORDER BY ci.priority_score DESC LIMIT 20
